newsitem.title: FRANCE: Tokyo to issue 1.7 bln Ffr 10-year eurobond Monday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo to issue 1.7 bln Ffr 10-year eurobond Monday.

text.p: The City of Tokyo plans to issue a 1.7 billion French franc 10-year eurobond on Monday priced at 12 basis points over equivalent French government bonds, sole lead manager IBJ France said on Friday.
IBJ France said it would be the first issue in French francs by Tokyo.

"French insurance companies are willing to diversify their portfolios with new top quality names and Japanese guaranteed entities are quite happy to tap the broad French investor base," an IBJ France banker told Reuters.
IBJ France has already lead managed, jointly with Banque Paribas, two French franc issues for Japanese borrowers so far in 1997.
